name: Products by Brand
description: List products for a given brand name.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.title, b.brand_name FROM amazon.products p JOIN amazon.brands b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id WHERE b.brand_name ILIKE '%Simms%' LIMIT 20

name: Products in Category
description: Products belonging to a specific category.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.title, c.category_name FROM amazon.products p JOIN amazon.product_categories pc ON p.product_id = pc.product_id JOIN amazon.categories c ON pc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name ILIKE '%yoga%' LIMIT 20

name: Also Bought Recommendations
description: Products frequently bought together with a given product.
sql: SELECT ab.product_id, p.title AS source_title, ab.related_product_id, rp.title AS related_title FROM amazon.also_buy ab JOIN amazon.products p ON ab.product_id = p.product_id JOIN amazon.products rp ON ab.related_product_id = rp.product_id LIMIT 20

name: Top Rated Products
description: Products with high average review ratings.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.title, AVG(r.overall) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM amazon.products p JOIN amazon.reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.title HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 20
